deviations_from_ac: None. All 6 AC items addressed and verified. The bead notes mentioned that the operator could choose to scope-add this work to wlsr.9 (option a) or leave it as a post-Wave-3 follow-on (option b); this completion implements option (b) cleanly via a separate bead. The wlsr.6 marker's recommendation_for_next was: 'Reconciler bootstrap: register this rule in src/lib/reconciler-bootstrap.ts (not done in this bead — out of scope; that wiring belongs to a separate integration bead or to wlsr.9). Until registered, the rule is exercised only by tests; no production effect.' — this bead is exactly that integration bead.
surprises_or_findings: The rule's builder factory exposes minTickIntervalMs as a documented option (CoherenceOutcomeAttributionRuleOptions interface in coherence-outcome-attribution.ts line 49-66). Other rules in bootstrap use a `throttled()` helper because their factories don't expose the setting (per the helper's own comment at bootstrap line 22-25). Passing minTickIntervalMs inline to the builder is cleaner and uses the rule's documented public surface; the throttled() wrapper is unnecessary. Both approaches are functionally equivalent (the reconciler reads rule.minTickIntervalMs at tick time either way). Documented this rationale inline in the registration block. Verified with full __tests__/lib suite (1143/1143 pass) that the wiring change does not regress any existing rule — including the existing coherence-outcome-attribution rule tests (which exercise the rule via its builder, not via bootstrap, so they were unaffected by the bootstrap change).
recommendation_for_next: Wave 2 is now complete for this follow-on. Reviewer Stage 4 should verify: (a) the registration block in reconciler-bootstrap.ts compiles and runs at boot (smoke test: start beads_web, hit any /api/fleet/action endpoint, confirm reconciler logs include the new rule via reconciler stats); (b) closeEpic emits the event in production (smoke test: deprioritise an epic via the dashboard, grep .beads/events.jsonl for `bead-status-changed` event with the right beadId/newStatus payload). For Wave 3 (wlsr.9 already closed; wlsr.14/15/16 already closed): no impact. The end-to-end signal loop is now closed: rule.act() in any non-success marker case → coherence dispatched → journal entry appended → wlsr.6 outcome rule attributes via re-escalation, closure event (now live), or 24h horizon. ADR-010's hybrid attribution is fully live in production.
